Article 41

Article 41 Work Year

Work Year

The following shall identify the 9-month and 10-month classifications and the duty days for which the superintendent will seek budgetary approval for each year of this contract. This listing does not imply a minimum guarantee commitment on the part of the Board.

Upon final Board action, following County Council approval, the number of duty days and paid days specified in the budget shall not be reduced during FY 1994.
